_note: The chat manager's rules (runs/renew.md step 6). It only ARCHIVES (Undo: unarchive in the app); it never deletes a chat. Edit this file to change what it keeps.
keep_rule: Never archive: a title in keep_titles; the dispatcher and chat manager made today; a chat that is running or working right now; a chat updated in the last 6 hours.

archive.what: Old dispatchers, renewers, chat managers and clocks (title starts 'iNiKKi Brain · dispatcher', 'iNiKKi · renewer', 'iNiKKi · chat manager', 'iNiKKi Engine · clock') that are not today's
Your own chats that finished (status idle or completed, nothing waiting on you)
Your own chats that wait on you but have not been touched

report: One line per archived chat in the reply: title · why. Chats it left alone because they wait on you: listed by title.
